mode: one sketch-to-render request per room; one precise-object-edit active-state request
common_prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Original production top-down three-quarter 2D cozy fantasy RPG background. Image 1 is exact layout/collision blueprint. Image 2 is accepted Old Mill receiving room or approach, STYLE reference for the rich painterly pixel-inspired materials, miniature perspective, colors, detail and texture, not its layout. Repaint FIRST image into the SECOND's style. Keep positions and footprints of all main objects. Wide 3:2 image intended at768×512. North/south doors centered x400, west/east openings centered y272. Preserve totally clear cross routes x360–440 full height and y240–304 full width, also empty anchor x208 y144. No added props in those clear paths. Match the exact blueprint composition. No text, numbers, labels, UI, characters or monsters. Do not retain flat vector outlines; produce detailed softly lit realistic game miniature art.

scene_briefs.approach: Woodland Old Mill approach: split hollow oak to the left, kingfisher perched beside narrow river on right, bridge in east-west path, partial old mill stone-and-timber entrance at top center, small westward trail to a quiet pool. Weathered timber doorway x400,y45 with warm lamps, roof receding beyond top edge. Lush diverse foliage, moss, wildflowers, roots, river ripples, stones, complex timber bridge planks, natural asymmetry. Existing Cadott town is style reference only.
scene_briefs.receiving: Quiet Old Mill receiving room: timber plank floor and narrow stone/wood walls. Upper-wall shelves of grain jars, barrels upper left, empty wooden handcart upper right, wooden freight desk bottom left holding an open ledger and balance scale, sacks and crates bottom right, worn teal entrance mat bottom center. Detailed woodgrain, beams, dust, brass lamps. Existing Kithlands shop is style reference only.
scene_briefs.grain-store: Old Mill GRAIN STORE: rich aged timber floor. Grain sacks stacked in three large bins upper left, upper right, lower right; sorting bench with burlap grain sacks lower left; single seed barrel mid-right; two upright narrow timber beams high center flanking the aisle. Small original brass wheel crank/handle with square socket rests clearly ON FRONT EDGE of northwest bin, accessible from empty floor. Subtle fine cobweb strands on upper-left sacks, no spiders. Rough hessian, twine, escaped golden grain, original authentic farming props.
scene_briefs.drying-room: Old Mill DRYING ROOM: weathered warm stone floor, four raised wooden grain drying mesh racks in corner quadrants, small banked warm brick stove middle right with narrow copper flue up east side. Racks contain dried grain, mesh and straw. Small closed RED-painted wooden supply box on front edge of upper-left rack, BLUE-painted box on upper-right rack. Both readable 24–30pixel props. No labels or symbols. Cozy muted colors, warm lamp light, tiny embers only inside stove.
scene_briefs.wheel-house: Old Mill WATERWHEEL HOUSE: damp stone floor, giant wooden waterwheel over river-blue rectangular basin in northeast quadrant, ancient bronze drive shaft along east edge, control valve and brass piping upper left, barrel upper left, wheelwright bench with spare gear and tools lower left, small stone debris cluster lower right. Unlit quiet mill, warm amber wall lamps, damp moss cracks. The big wheel is the dominant landmark. Do not enlarge its basin outside the exact blueprint footprint.
scene_briefs.maintenance: Old Mill MILLWRIGHT WORKSHOP: richly textured timber floor, tool bench and worn hammer/chisels upper left, parts shelf upper right, a plan-reading desk at upper right mid height, barrel left mid height, two spare cog wheels lower left, solid staircase to a loft lower right with banisters. Detailed authentic woodworking tools, sawdust in corners, warm oil lamps.
scene_briefs.loft: Old Mill GRAIN LOFT: warmly textured aged timber planks, rough wooden hay drying bins upper left/upper right/lower left, a barrel left mid height, triangular roof supports near upper center on either side of clear north aisle, rope hoist and guarded hatch lower right. Bins hold actual cut golden straw, hatch dark and securely railed, subtle dusty afternoon light. Do not draw roof over room.
scene_briefs.root-cellar: Old Mill ROOT CELLAR: damp textured mossy stone floor, old stone walls, roots curling down left/right side walls. Upper-left and upper-right shelves hold glazed jars of preserves; clusters of large casks lower left and lower right; cracked mossy boulder mid-right; a few small pale mushrooms mid-left. Small keeper's parchment note pinned to front of northwest shelf, accessible from clear x208,y144; faint abstract marks not readable text. Ancient foundations and quiet watery reflections. No roots intruding into central paths.
scene_briefs.heron-pool: Secret HERON POOL on a woodland mill trail. Northwest stone heron statue perched on mossy boulder. Southwest natural still pool with lily pads and reeds. Eastern narrow river and broad wooden bridge. Small dry fishing SATCHEL beside stone heron's base, accessible from nearby trail x208,y144. Lower-right tree replaced by LOW wildflower shrub so wooden cache is visible. Peaceful dappled afternoon light. Dense mixed deciduous trees, natural canopies, moss, roots, gold-green leaf litter, small wildflowers. No building.
scene_briefs.sluice-gallery: Old Mill SLUICE GALLERY: damp stone hydraulic chamber. Four rectangular racewater basins occupy corners, leaving broad cross-shaped stone causeway. Two ancient brass sluice control valves in upper half on either side of central north route. Northwest pool has little stone landing jutting from east edge at x170–240,y118–174: retain walkable landing. Warm lanterns, detailed old river stone, moss, reflected water light, strong guard rims around water, bronze pipes. Practical antique weathered machinery. No new causeway objects.
scene_briefs.mill-heart: Old Mill MILL HEART: circular worn pale millstone inlaid FLUSH with floor in center, readable open arena (not raised, no center hole). Ancient big twisted tree roots clustered ONLY upper-left, lower-left and lower-right, embracing cracked foundation blocks. Large wooden drive gear and bronze shaft upper-right. Small closed keepsake chest in upper-left root cluster, metal fittings with amber jewel detail. Keep adjacent x208,y144 walkable. Mossy stone walls, glints of fresh water, muted moss green and amber. Quiet renewal, kid-safe. No creature or guardian baked into art, no thorns in central arena.
scene_briefs.tailrace: Old Mill TAILRACE EXIT LANDING: woodland return beside flowing blue-green river and east wooden bridge. Retired heavy millstone west x128,y170; northwest broken stone mill gatepost and wildflowers; southwest stone-lined shallow mill settling basin with clear rippling water, no lily pads. North-center transverse timber GATE with liftable long wooden bar; path immediately south remains clear. North path continues to root cellar doorway beyond top. Golden afternoon light, tidy banks and reeds, old masonry, dense riverside trees. Southeast low grasses. Restored local mill and warm return to town.

wheel_house_active_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is the approved Old Mill waterwheel-house game background. Make ONE active-state variant of exactly this image. Preserve the entire room, perspective, composition, sizes, wall positions, floor tiles, object footprints, colors and camera pixel-for-pixel as much as possible. ONLY change the waterwheel basin upper right and north doorway small threshold: fresh teal-blue flowing water and distinct modest white froth now churn inside existing basin, the big waterwheel's spokes have rotated about 15 degrees and a few little water droplets on the paddles suggest movement (crisp readable, no motion blur). The repaired bronze control handle at upper-left is slightly polished warm brass, not glowing. Across north doorway at top center, clearly show a small raised-into-place timber service bridge threshold with three narrow horizontal planks and little metal bracket ends; keep it inside the existing doorway footprint, walkable, no stairs obstructing path. This is a still frame active-state visual, do not change collision. No new large bridge crossing the room, no change to any room objects or lighting elsewhere. No text, effects over walkways, people, monsters or interface. Output same1536×1024 3:2 aspect.
